The IONITY PASSPORT MOTION is ideal for drivers who usually take short to medium trips but sometimes venture further afield. With a low monthly fee that covers itself after just one charge, you’ll save on every kWh used!

The IONITY PASSPORT POWER is perfect for those who regularly travel long distances. After your second charge, the monthly fee effectively pays for itself, offering substantial savings on each kWh.

Benefits of both plans include:
• Significantly lower kWh prices than non-subscription charging
• No peak or seasonal price changes
• Flexible terms — change plans or cancel monthly
• Easy subscription and payment directly through the IONITY app


ABOUT IONITY 

IONITY is building and operating the largest open brand high-power charging (HPC) network along European highways. The HPC charging capacity of up to 350 kW allows maximum charging speeds. As a commitment to sustainability, IONITY sources renewable energy only for both emission-free and carbon neutral driving. 

Founded in 2017, IONITY is a joint venture of the car manufacturers BMW Group, Ford Motor Company, Hyundai Motor Group, Mercedes Benz AG and Volkswagen Group with Audi and Porsche, along with BlackRock’s Global Renewable Power platform as financial investor. The company is headquartered in Munich, Germany, with additional offices in Dortmund and outside Norway's capital Oslo. IONITY is an internationally registered trademark.
